notablePrerequisites: Infinite Reflection attached to Dromar's Attendant.
description:
Cast Sandbar Merfolk either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {U}, causing it to enter the battlefield as a copy of Dromar's Attendant due to Infinite Reflection.
Activate Sandbar Merfolk by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {W}{U}{B}.
If you cast Sandbar Merfolk from your graveyard, Sandbar Merfolk is not exiled by Abandoned Sarcophagus due to Infinite Reflection removing Sandbar Merfolk's cycling ability.
Repeat.
